    All Classes and Interfaces

    Classes
    Class
    Description
    Comment
    A Comment is an Element and is similar to a RMLList but it only stores RMLString
    Element
    An abstract class to create new Elements
    ElementJSON
    Contains methods that are used to convert RML Elements into JSON using Gson
    JSONSerializer
    Uses Gson to serialize a stored RMLFile into JSON
    KeyValueElement
    A KeyValueElement is an Element containing a key, value and a comment
    Main
    The CLI to create a JSON file from a RML File using commands in the Terminal
    Parser
    Class to parse files into RMLFile instances
    RMLBoolean
    A RMLType subclass to represent boolean
    RMLDate
    A RMLType subclass to represent date
    RMLDateTime
    Not implemented yet
    RMLFile
    A RMLFile instance holds the file's name, the file_header (RMLFileHeader), and all of it's sections in a LinkedHashSet
    RMLFileHeader
    The header section of a RMLFile that might contain file information and metadata
    RMLList
    A RMLList is an Element that contains a non-empty list of RMLTypes
    RMLNumber
    A RMLType subclass to represent numbers
    RMLString
    A RMLType subclass to represent Strings
    RMLTime
    A RMLType subclass to represent time
    RMLType
    An abstract class to group RMLTypes
    RMLValue<T>
    A Class to store RMLType's child classes for Elements
    Section
    A Section is a Element that stores elements except for Sections themselves
    SubSection
    A SubSection is also an Element except it extends Section
